name: SaaS Standard (Python)
why: The same proven SaaS shape for Python-preferring teams, and the natural pick when the app's core involves data processing or ML.
tradeoffs: Two languages (Python back, TS front); API types must be kept in sync.
avoid_when: The team wants one language everywhere — use the TypeScript standard.

build_order.title: Scaffold the app
build_order.description: FastAPI backend and React front boot together with a health check.

build_order.title: Model the data
build_order.description: Postgres schema and SQLAlchemy models for the core entities.

build_order.title: Add accounts
build_order.description: Sign-up and sign-in guarding the API and the app pages.

build_order.title: Build the core features
build_order.description: The must-have features working end to end against real data.

build_order.title: Wire payments
build_order.description: Stripe checkout and webhooks for the paid tier, when the product charges.

build_order.title: Polish and harden
build_order.description: Error states, notifications and admin touches, and green end-to-end tests.

testing_defaults.tiers: test-first business logic and endpoints; smoke/integration for UI

philosophy_fit: Moderate: free-first achievable; heavier than the lightweight tool stack.
